data.name: Spontaneous Domain Casting
data.description: A tempest druid can channel stored spell energy into domain spells that he has not prepared ahead of time. He can "lose" a prepared spell to cast any domain spell of the same level or lower. This replaces the druid's normal ability to spontaneously cast summon spells.
